items.text: Minnesota QB: Kyler Murray (Grade 2 hamstring strain) OUT; Carson Wentz starts, Max Brosmer backup.
items.source: ESPN (Vikings to start Wentz vs. Bills)

items.text: Minnesota (final): OUT - WR Jauan Jennings (calf), RB Demond Claiborne (knee). Questionable - S Theo Jackson (quad), S Jay Ward (knee). LT Christian Darrisaw, OLB Andrew Van Ginkel, CB Isaiah Rodgers, LB Jake Golday no designation, expected to play.

Buffalo (final): OUT - WR Joshua Palmer (hamstring). Questionable - LT Dion Dawkins (rib; DNP all week, Tylan Grable would start), LG Alec Anderson (ankle; limited Sat, 'close call', Austin Corbett would start), DL Greg Gaines (calf), DB Jordan Hancock (hamstring), WR Tyrell Shavers (knee). S C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended. Josh Allen starts.
Buffalo OL: Dawkins and Anderson both game-time decisions; inactives (~6:45 pm ET) not yet posted at time of writing.
